description:
Command-line entry point over the JDK HttpTransport and Jackson 3 JsonCodec. The plain
    artifact is a normal (non-executable) jar of just this module's own classes; the
    executable uber-jar for `java -jar` is published separately under the `all` classifier
    (typesafe-java-cli-VERSION-all.jar), so a plain dependency on typesafe-java-cli never
    pulls in unrelocated, bundled copies of its dependencies.
